answer: No certified ember detector can fill two paid watches on the same voyage. The dispatch board keeps one factory-provisioned cipher key per detector serial. It verifies an authenticated tag over a fresh nonce, the voyage ID and the agent key, then atomically marks that serial used before hiring. Replays and relays to a used detector cannot open another slot. One honest agent needs 1 enrolled detector. Filling 1,000 slots through aliases requires 1,000 detectors on that voyage. A farm can rent units, and a factory that registers multiple serials per unit defeats the limit.
